Local landscaping

Landscaping in Blair Athol, built for the slope

Blair Athol is one of Campbelltown's established, elevated family suburbs. The blocks are generous but often sloping, which means levels, retaining and drainage have to be planned before the pretty part goes in. Done right, a sloping block becomes usable terraced space rather than a hill you avoid.

We handle the whole yard under one licence, quote a fixed price after seeing the slope and soil, and never charge a call-out fee.

Get your fixed-price quote

FAQs

Landscaping in Blair Athol: your questions answered

Is my sloping Blair Athol block suitable for a retaining wall?
Almost always, but the build has to suit reactive Wianamatta clay: engineered footings and proper ag-drainage so moisture movement does not push the wall out. We assess the slope and soil on site and quote a wall that will hold.
Do you do full backyard makeovers in Blair Athol?
Yes. From terracing a slope to a complete design, build and planting, we do the lot in-house and give you a fixed price with a clear timeline.
Do you charge a call-out fee?
No. Coming out to look at your job and quote it is free, every time. You only pay once you accept a fixed-price quote and we get to work.
Are you licensed and insured?
Yes, we are a licensed contractor. We are happy to show our credentials before any work starts, so you know exactly who is on your property.
How soon can you start?
Often quickly, especially for smaller jobs and quotes. We are open 7am to 7pm, 7 days, so call 0451 267 287 and we will tell you honestly what we can do.
